title: UserMap
description: Users added directly to teams and roles, without an Entra group. Optional file env/<env>/users.yaml, git-ignored (tenant emails and object IDs). Matched on oid only; an entry without an oid grants nothing.

email.description: Entra sign-in name (UPN/email); used only to look up the oid (sdlc-config users sync)

oid.description: Entra object ID of the user: the only value matched against tokens

teams.description: team -> roles in that team (like a team membership entry)

default_team.description: team the agent uses when a document's team is not clear from the conversation (version-03 P10 G9); guidance only, applies only while the user is a member
